desc: Derive the assignment formulation: select exactly \(2K\) cakes, assign each to one coordinate, require every coordinate class to have even size, and maximize assigned coordinate values.
Prove that any feasible assignment yields valid disjoint pairs with at least the assigned-value total, while an optimal pairing induces an assignment of equal value.
Establish and prove a bounded-modification theorem relative to the unconstrained top-\(2K\) baseline, accounting for both reassignment and selected/unselected swaps.
Design an efficient constant-size candidate enumeration or dynamic program for the bounded modifications, with no \(\Theta(N^2)\) pair generation.
Correct the parity-grouped compatibility/conflict bitsets using globally unique operation indices and local parity-group conversion.
Exhaustively compare the corrected algorithm with brute force for small random instances and edge cases.
Implement and validate the final Python solution with fast I/O and 64-bit-safe arithmetic.
